text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? ...Whoa, what the!?
I-Is that who I think it is over there...!?

text_block_list.name: School Newspaper Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really looking forward to your discussion tomorrow!
I'm certain it will make for a fantastic academy newspaper feature!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes, I have heard.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Allow me to show you...
what true strength is.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (A talk between Ramonu-san and Gentile-san!? Wh-whoa! It's like a dream...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! That discussion...
Would it be alright if I helped out too?!

One afternoon. Under the clear blue sky,
I saw Rhein Kraft getting ready for a tea party.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, your seats are right over here! Please enjoy some
tea and cake to accompany your discussion!
choice_data_list: What is with that gigantic cake...?

text_block_list.name: School Newspaper Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, a three-tiered cake...!?
Don't tell me you prepared this, Craft-san!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I wanted to make a gorgeous cake...
one worthy of two runners who race so
majestically and overpoweringly!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to make it three layers.
I was hoping... it would express a sparkling kind of strength, like the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Strength, you say. My...
Now that is a commendable mindset."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ! No, not at all! It's something I wanted to do myself!

text_block_list.name: School Newspaper Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the interview!
Would you mind taking a quick photo at the end?

text_block_list.name: School Newspaper Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Amazing, your expression and pose are both perfect...
Absolutely flawless!

text_block_list.name: School Newspaper Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!
I managed to take the best photo ever~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um. Would it be... difficult
to let us keep filming
just a little longer?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, why is that?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The photos from earlier were wonderful, of course!
But... there is a certain shot of you two
that I absolutely must capture..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Um, I want to share that brilliance with everyone... the kind that makes admiration blossom in your heart...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That unwavering confidence—believing that she,
above all others, was worthy of the Triple Tiara...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I want to capture that beautiful radiance in my viewfinder!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Because I've been watching...
that sparkle the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
An innocent—and pure passion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
Please, do as you please.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I do not mind either. Please show me
what kind of photo the longing in your heart will create...

While Rhein Kraft enthusiastically helped the reporters,
the photoshoot continued as the two discussed the Triple Tiara.
Before long—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now then, as for the photo we'll use...
Craft-san—would you choose it?

text_block_list.name: School Newspaper Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please, from me as well!
Thanks to Craft-san's advice,
I managed to take a lot of great photos!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
E-Eh!? A-Are you sure...?
Then—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'd like to go with this one!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, not bad at all.
Please, suit yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
So that is your "love"—
Well, isn't that lovely.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!
Yes, thank you so much!
choice_data_list: Glad to see it got picked.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. ...Ehehe,
I wonder if they took a liking to me...
choice_data_list: Maybe someday I'll get to sit down and talk with those two!
I can't wait for the day the article comes out.
I'm looking forward to the day the article comes out!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. ...Ehehe,
I wonder if they took a liking to me...
choice_data_list: Maybe someday I'll get to sit down and talk with those two!
I can't wait for the day the article comes out.
I'm looking forward to the day the article comes out!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh... EEEHHH~!?
M-Me!?
choice_data_list: Because it seems both of them have acknowledged you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no! Compared to you two,
I'm still just a little fledgling bird!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"From now on, it's all about hard work!
Just like the two of you... no――"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Just like all the Tiara Umamusume, I want to become an Umamusume that someone can look up to!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: You're right! I want even just one person to feel that same passion, just like I did!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Incredible...! I can't take my eyes off this photo in the school newspaper...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"She's practically radiating confidence—
This is the brilliance truly worthy
of the Triple Tiara...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.
